info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Loan Application By Collateral Id-spec
info.description: This API enables financial institutions to update specific loan applications associated with a given collateral ID. By utilizing PATCH requests, users can modify details of loan applications, enhancing the management of collateralized loans. Typical consumers include loan officers and application processors who need to ensure that the loan application reflects the most current information regarding associated collateral. This functionality supports effective loan management practices and improves the overall accuracy of financial records.

patch.summary: Update collateral for loan application RES-100045
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the collateral information associated with the loan application identified by RES-100045. Provide the necessary data to modify the existing collateral details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to partially update the collateral information associated with the specified loan application. It allows clients to modify specific fields of the collateral without needing to resend the entire object.
